title: track.set
description: Sets the mute, solo, volume and colour of tracks, as OpenTune's track panel does. tracks names every track at most once (else INVALID_ARGUMENT(duplicate_track)), and a trackId that names no track slot gives NOT_FOUND(unknown_handle); either way nothing changes. volumeDb or volumeLinear sets the volume; OpenTune's volume knob covers the linear range 0 to 4, and a value outside it is limited to it (warning CLAMPED, subject the track, data {field, requested, applied}). Solo changes which other tracks are audible: changes lists the members that changed for every track, among them audible, also for tracks the call did not name. Colours are #RRGGBB. The settings are saved with the project, so the project is marked as changed. As in OpenTune there is no undo entry: the undo reason is ui_parity, and the revert recipe sets the previous values of the members the call changed, with track.set. Settings equal to the current ones are a no-op.
